name: Solar panel
description: 200 W, 12 V nominal, monocrystalline, 36-cell type. Target open-circuit voltage about 22–29 V. The plan allows two 100 W panels in parallel. Verify compatibility with the controller.
vendor_leads: Kinigi Energy or Great Lakes Energy.

name: LiFePO4 battery
description: 12.8 V, 100 Ah. BMS rated at least 100 A with low-temperature cutoff. Look for a unit made in 2025 or later and a written warranty.
vendor_leads: Shopit.rw (Snadi), Kinigi Energy, Great Lakes Energy or African Energy.

name: DC breaker for the panel
description: 16 A, DC-rated.
vendor_leads: Kinigi Energy or Great Lakes Energy.

name: Battery fuse with holder
description: About 30 A, including a holder.

name: 6-way blade fuse block
description: Six-way block with 3 A blade fuses. Plan on one fuse per socket and keep spares.

name: Solar cable and MC4 leads
description: 6 mm² solar cable in red and black, plus two ready-made MC4 leads.

name: Battery leads
description: 6 mm² battery leads with ring lugs crimped in the shop.

name: Battery and controller box
description: Lockable and ventilated, steel or plastic. The plan places it out of direct sun.

name: Panel frame
description: Angle-iron frame with bolts, tilted about 10° for rain runoff.

name: ESP32 dev board
description: Original ESP32 with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. Match the pinout in the project plan. ESP32-S2, ESP32-S3 and ESP32-C3 have different pinouts.
vendor_leads: Faranux (about 15,340 RWF each) or SoftTech (13,500 RWF each).

name: 6-channel 5 V relay board
description: Six-channel relay module with 5 V control.

name: INA219 current sensor (MCU-219)
description: One per socket plus one spare. Ask for the header pins to be soldered.

name: Controller signal resistors
description: 10 kΩ and 20 kΩ resistors for the controller signal. Confirm both values.

name: Wiring parts
description: Screw terminal blocks, Dupont jumper wires and a perfboard.

name: Hub box
description: Weatherproof IP65 enclosure, about 250 × 200 × 120 mm, with six socket holes.

name: Soldering iron and solder
description: For the sensor header pins if soldering is unavailable at the shop.

name: MTN 4G MiFi
description: 4G MiFi device with a planned 30 GB monthly bundle. The checklist references *345# for the bundle.

name: Customer charging cables
description: 6 × USB-A to micro-USB, 6 × USB-C to USB-C, 2 × USB-A to Lightning.

name: Test phones
description: Low-cost itel or Tecno Android phones with USB-C to use as test loads.
budget_basis: Planned budget for the two phones

name: Consumables
description: Cable ties, insulating tape, screws, wall plugs and a padlock. The plan puts these in the approximately USD 100 cash float.

name: Numbered tamper seals
description: For the hub box, battery box and spares.

name: Insulated screwdrivers and pliers
description: Insulated hand tools for work near the battery.
